title: 'No deadline for Sheikh Hasina's return', says Indian high commissioner in Bangladesh
content: High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi addressed the extradition request for Sheikh Hasina from Bangladesh, stating that the matter is under legal review, preventing a set timeline for her repatriation. He clarified that India had no involvement in her arrival, citing the dire circumstances in Bangladesh. As relations between India and Bangladesh grow increasingly strained, the new Bangladeshi government remains resolute in pursuing Hasina's extradition.

title: 21 Gold, 27 Silver & 37 Bronze: India's medal frenzy at Asian Games ends with a bang
content: The Aichi-Nagoya campaign produced a mix of expected results and disappointments before India's strong finish changed the picture. As recently as Thursday, India were outside the top 10 in the medal table with only 10 gold medals.

title: Hope battles cramps as WI chase down 352 to beat India by 5 wickets
content: Hope overshadowed KL Rahul’s counterattacking unbeaten 129 off 87 balls that propelled India to 351/7. Dew may have played a part, but Hope’s experience tamed down India’s inexperienced bowling with consummate ease

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30M to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
content: MacKenzie Scott has made headlines with her unprecedented $30 million donation to Housing Trust Silicon Valley, marking the organization's largest-ever gift. This investment is set to bolster affordable housing options throughout the Bay Area, as the trust plans to enhance its loan fund and expand various housing initiatives over the next decade.

title: How landlord won tax relief on Rs 14.96 lakh demonetisation cash deposit
content: The Bangalore bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) recently held that rental income already disclosed to the income tax authorities can be considered as an identifiable source of cash deposited into a bank account at a later date. Even where a landlord claims to have collected rent in cash, the subsequent deposit of that money cannot be disregarded merely because the rental earnings have already been taxed.

title: Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers
content: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail.

title: Garth Stein’s restored Seattle ‘forever house’ lists for $2.45 million
content: Garth Stein and his wife are selling their Seattle home after living there for 25 years. They purchased the property in 2001, aiming to raise their children there. The home has been extensively renovated while maintaining its original character and charm. Located in the Mount Baker neighborhood, the house features stunning views and modern amenities. This marked listing reflects their transition as their youngest child heads to college.

title: Iowa family auctions 1,209-acre farm after 84 years on the land
content: On October 30, a landmark auction will take place for the 1,209-acre farmland portfolio owned by the Woods family in Fayette County. This well-preserved parcel boasts high-quality soil, attracting a variety of potential buyers—from local farmers to investors and recreational users. The hybrid auction setup will enable competitive bidding on individual lots, marking the culmination of the family’s 84-year legacy with the land.

title: What took 10 Google engineers six months now happens overnight, says Eric Schmidt
content: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt says the best programmers no longer write code. Speaking at Harvard's John F. Kennedy Jr. Forum, Schmidt described an engineer who writes specifications and evaluation criteria, lets AI run overnight, and wakes up to finished work. He argued AI will make top engineers more valuable, automate core business operations like billing and logistics, and predicted artificial general intelligence (AGI) could arrive as early as 2029.

title: Utah man built backyard railroad with 40,000 pounds of gravel and $18,000 budget
content: Cory Mohl from West Valley City has constructed a remarkable backyard railroad project, aiming to share his love for trains with the community. He dedicated significant time and resources to build around 400 feet of track, attracting local children who delight in riding the miniature train. This charming setup has become a beloved neighborhood fixture, encouraging connections among residents.

title: Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes' 1587 restaurant lawsuit takes new turn
content: Amid ongoing trademark issues, Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes are throwing their weight behind 1587 Prime, which has just garnered a spot on Yelp's list of Best New Restaurants for 2026. The dispute involves trademark claims from 1587 Sneakers, alleging infringement concerning their sneaker line. Seeking to distance the athletes from the legal matter, their lawyers are taking action while 1587 Prime thrives amid the conflict.

title: How Maria Sharapova built a $220 million fortune beyond tennis
content: Sharapova used her tennis success to build a bigger business career after retiring. Her estimated $220 million fortune has been tied to career earnings, global endorsements, Sugarpova and investments in consumer, wellness, fitness and technology companies, allowing the five-time Grand Slam champion to build a financial portfolio outside of professional tennis.

title: At 6, Dylan Siegel wrote a book for a friend; it raised $1m for research
content: At 6, Los Angeles boy Dylan Siegel wrote and sold a book calledChocolate Barto help fund research into his best friend Jonah’s rare liver disorder. What began as a child’s idea grew into a fundraising effort that had raised $1 million by 2014.

title: Helicopters, influencers and nail art: The money trail of 2026 assembly elections
content: The BJP and Congress have filed their election expenditure reports following several assembly elections this year. The BJP recorded a hefty expenditure of Rs 529.39 crore across five states, whereas Congress spent Rs 248.55 crore. These contrasting figures unveil the distinct priorities of the political parties, particularly in West Bengal and Keralam.

title: Congress resets Team UP: 5 clear messages for BJP and Akhilesh Yadav
content: Congress has overhauled its Uttar Pradesh unit ahead of the 2027 UP assembly election, appointing three-time MLA Aradhana Misra Mona as state president and Imran Masood as working president. The Congress reshuffle brings Brahmin, Muslim, OBC, Dalit and women representation into its leadership team, signalling a push to rebuild its organisation, expand its social base and strengthen its position in talks with Samajwadi Party.

title: Russia to take 70,000 Indian skilled workers this year, Jaishankar tells panel
content: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar briefed a parliamentary committee on India's engagement with Russia and Ukraine. He highlighted bilateral trade expansion and India's aim to send skilled workers. The minister discussed India's diplomatic efforts to facilitate dialogue for ending the Ukraine conflict. Additionally, he noted the government's initiatives to release Indian nationals in the Russian military. Jaishankar emphasized India's commitment to secure economic interests and safeguard Indian citizens abroad.

title: TGIKS5: Kapil takes a dig Anup Soni as Ajay Devgn replaces him on Crime Patrol
content: The latest episode of The Great Indian Kapil Show welcomed the cast of The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest. Kapil Sharma humorously addressed Anup Soni about his replacement on Crime Patrol by Ajay Devgn. Sidharth Malhotra shared his childhood experiences with supposedly haunted houses in his neighborhood. Maniesh Paul recounted a funny story about his daughter's encounters with an imaginary 'aunty' in their home.

title: Akhilesh asks SP leaders to keep seat-sharing concerns with Congress internal
content: Akhilesh Yadav, president of the Samajwadi Party, encouraged leaders to express seat-sharing concerns privately. Tensions arose after Shiv Pal Singh Patel criticized Congress' demand for 150 seats in upcoming elections. Patel emphasized that Congress should receive a more realistic allocation based on their previous performance. Uttar Pradesh Congress president Aradhana Mishra stated that top leadership will decide the seat allocation.

title: Kolkata, AIFF pull out all stops for India vs Brazil but crowd stays away
content: In many ways, it was a historic occasion. Brazil hadn't faced a team as lower ranked than India in 28 years. India hadn't gone up against a team as higher ranked as Brazil since rankings were introduced in August 1993. It helps significantly that Kolkata raves over Brazil (and Argentina).

title: Influencer Mad Sandhu shot dead in Amritsar
content: Mad Sandhu was shot dead on Saturday in the Pratap Nagar area of Amritsar, Punjab. Preliminary information suggests that assailants opened fire at him, resulting in his death. Police arrived at the scene shortly after receiving information about the shooting. An investigation has been launched to determine the circumstances surrounding the incident. The identities of the assailants remain unknown at this time.

title: Ukraine confirms India playing big role in mediating energy truce in Black Sea
content: Ukraine has expressed readiness to explore India's comprehensive proposal for ending the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. During recent communications, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha emphasized the importance of India's mediation role. India's external affairs minister S Jaishankar affirmed continuous engagement with both Kyiv and Moscow regarding potential solutions. Ukraine is open to discussing limited ceasefire arrangements around energy infrastructure and safe Black Sea shipping.

title: We seem to be learning that currency depreciation is not always bad: Panagariya
content: Arvind Panagariya, chairman of the 16th Finance Commission, outlines the benefits of a weaker rupee for exports. He stresses that rising import costs can maintain the competitiveness of domestic products. The need for tariff cuts, elimination of quality control orders, and revision of bilateral investment treaties is emphasized. Panagariya also mentions the current economic stability and potential growth of 7-8%. He expresses optimism despite external challenges affecting growth prospects.

title: 'Parents oppose marriage': Andhra man kills 19-year-old girlfriend, jumps to death
content: Mahalakshmi, a young woman of 19, lost her life after a brutal knife attack by her ex-boyfriend, Chinna Rao, aged 22. The assault occurred at her home, where Chinna's persistent harassment, stemming from family opposition, culminated in violence. Mahalakshmi suffered grave injuries and passed away after four hours in the hospital. In a heartbreaking conclusion, Chinna leaped from a building, ending his life shortly after the attack.

title: AAP suspends Punjab MLA after he flags teacher shortage in emotional video
content: sukhveer Singh Maiserkhana raises teacher shortage in schools in emotional video . he posted video highlighting shortage of teachers in his constituency . this comes after he appeared emotional while raising the issue on social media .

title: IAF chief says war widow Priyanka Saxena to be trained, reinstated as Squadron Leader
content: Priyanka Saxena was commissioned into the IAF in 2003 and served for 10 years in the logistics branch before leaving service in Dec 2013 due to family commitments . she will be reinstated as a squadron leader on the court orders as 11th year .

content: "as of today, about 125-140 square kilometres have been de-occupied," Zelensky said . the operation is a name given by Ukraine’s armed forces to an ongoing counteroffensive in the Lyman direction in northern donetsk region .

title: 'Putin's not as strong as he appears, knows Ukraine war a mistake': Russia's ex-PM
content: former prime minister says he is not ready to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine . he believes high oil prices linked to the US-Iran conflict and disagreements between the united states and Europe had strengthened Putin's position . title: Drug addicts turn to painkillers amid Nasha Mukt crackdown in J&K
content: drug users and peddlers in jammu & Kashmir are increasingly turning to pharmaceutical opioids, primarily painkillers . investigators have so far led to the recovery of 2,19,425 tablets and capsules of pharmaceutical drugs . 3.830 kg of codeine-containing liquid, including the storage containers, police said .

title: British Indian pair fight extradition to US over alleged cancer drug fraud
content: wealthy businessman and his ex-wife are battling extradition to the us . they face charges of smuggling unapproved medical drugs into the u.s. and defrauding insurance plans such as Medicare of millions of dollars .

title: India summons Pak envoy over 'cross-border infiltration', rejects Ferozepur claims
content: the ministry of external affairs summoned the chargé d'affaires of the Pakistan high commission to lodge a strong protest . it rejected as “baseless and motivated” Pakistan’s allegations over an October 2 incident in the Ferozepur sector of Punjab along the International Border .

title: Kashmir professor removed for ‘harassing’ students
content: chemistry department head has been removed after some female students accused him of harassing them and asking one of them out on a date . registrar says he assured them that anyone using 'such language' should be reported to university authorities immediately .

title: PoK woman crosses LoC in Rajouri, detained
content: a 19-year-old woman from Pakistan-occupied Kashmir was intercepted by army personnel after she crossed the LoC in J&K's Rajouri district . she was later handed over to police officers for further detention and inquiries .

title: Road injuries 10th leading cause for deaths in India: WHO report
content: 'falls' was the eighth biggest cause of deaths among males in 2023 . road traffic injuries ranked the 10th leading cause of death for both males and females in india . fatalities due to falls ranked 9th .
